prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been overestimated compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +0.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +3.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.2%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_time_estimate: Displays a dynamic progress bar and estimated time remaining on the waiting screen while pet assets are generated. (why: The home waiting step has a median time of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty and user drop-off during background pet rendering.)
1: [finish, new_screen] new_desktop_pet_welcome_screen: Adds a new post-onboarding summary screen that highlights how to find, right-click, and toggle the pet on the desktop. (why: Support emails show frequent user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_split_layout: Changes the choose_path screen layout to a side-by-side split view highlighting ready-made pet vs custom photo upload options. (why: Choose path has a 23.8% drop-off rate and an 8-second median time, showing users need clearer visual contrast between options.)
3: [finish, redesign] home_intro_centered_redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen into a clear centered view with explicit desktop controls instructions. (why: Finish step drop-off is 22.8% and support reported post-onboarding confusion around managing desktop pets.)
4: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_quality_tip: Adds a detailed tip on photo selection criteria directly on the photo upload screen. (why: Support received reports of custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect, contributing to a 31.6% drop-off at adoption.)
5: [sign_in, notification] sign_in_session_status_notify: Enables a background status notification indicator during authentication so users know sign-in is actively working. (why: Support tickets noted sign-in screens stalling or failing to appear, driving a 27.1% sign-in drop-off rate.)
6: [choose_path, copy] story_headline_clarity_boost: Updates the initial story screen text to set expectations about quick setup and instant desktop pet availability. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at the very first choose_path step with a long mean duration of 514s.)
7: [adoption, layout] upload_photos_grid_layout: Switches the photo upload screen to a grid layout for easier photo management and visual feedback. (why: Adoption has a low 68.4% conversion and long median duration of 89s due to photo upload friction.)
8: [home, new_flow] new_waiting_interactive_tips_flow: Inserts an interactive tip screen during the waiting process so users can read pet control tips while generation completes. (why: Waiting step drop-off is 18.7% with high mean time (2336s), leaving users unengaged during backend setup.)
9: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_after_adoption_reorder: Moves the sign-in step after pet selection and customization so users invest in their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early in the funnel before they have experienced the pet creation core value.)

scores.note: Home step has long duration; time estimate provides context during background loading.
Finish step has clear support evidence, but new_screen changes show 0.0% lift historically.
Visual layout split addresses choose_path drop-off based on funnel data alone.
Finish redesign matches support reports and aligns with measured +3.9% lift for this kind of change.
Adoption has highest drop-off (31.6%); low-cost hint directly addresses reported upload errors.
Addresses sign-in drop-off (27.1%) and specific support reports regarding stalling status.
Cheap config/copy update to address initial choose_path step duration and drop-off.
Targets highest drop-off step (adoption, 31.6%) and long median duration (89s).
New flow changes have shown no positive impact across historical tests.
Sign_in reorder showed severe negative lift (-7.2%) in measured test.
